items.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I know his family good. They used to live right at the corner from us, Sonny.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. Oh, yeah. He was good on it, too. Yeah, yeah. He was pretty good on it, too. That's right. Yeah, Lil Basie. Yeah. He went to California. What's his right name? Did you know?
Uh. I know his family good. They used to live right at the corner from us, Sonny. Yeah. Right at Orleans and Roman. Yeah. Mitchell. Mitchell.
